$comment: GitHub decomposition and provider-role conclusions for Code Governance MVP. Documentation-only.
rejected_architecture: three-GitHub-provider model (GitHub as one provider with descriptors across all three families) — REJECTED in v0.1->v0.2 and NOT reopened

ASSERTION_GOVERNANCE.github_role: NONE — GitHub evidence ingestion is NOT an assertion-governance provider

ACTION_GOVERNANCE.github_role: NONE — GitHub action construction is a product mapping layer in the Workflow Service, NOT an action-governance provider

EXTERNAL_EXECUTION.github_role: THE ONLY GitHub governance-provider role proposed for MVP implementation
EXTERNAL_EXECUTION.reference_pattern: actiongate_provider/ (pure offline core + thin BaseProvider adapter + errors/translate + versioned mapping + conformance suite)
EXTERNAL_EXECUTION.maturity: MISSING (only the framework DeterministicExecutionProvider test-double exists)

github_evidence_connector.disposition: PRODUCT_CONNECTOR (option 1: normal product adapter / connector package outside GPF)
github_evidence_connector.rationale: It reads GitHub (PR/commit/CI/review/scanner) and emits immutable, provenance-bound evidence refs consumed by TAP. It performs no assertion governance, so it is NOT an ASSERTION_GOVERNANCE provider and must NOT create a new provider family merely to be registered. There is no existing evidence-provider abstraction to reuse (evidence subsystem is neutral research code with no durable store), so it is net-new product code.
rejected_options: new provider family (would be MAJOR freeze change and conflate roles)

workflow_service.disposition: NEW product package using existing patterns; owns coordination state only, NO authority
workflow_service.note: No durable workflow engine exists as code (agent_runtime_v2 is docs-only; agent_runtime_migration is in-memory). Workflow Service must supply its own durable state or depend on a to-be-built persistence layer.
